title: Migrating Birds Can’t Find Their Way Home
main_content:
Scientists say a huge percentage of bird species are in danger because their habitats are disappearing.

The scientists studied the migration (or flight) and paths of almost 1,500 species. They decided that 91 percent of them passed through dangerous areas.

The danger for migratory birds is development. Building and paving have covered over the nature where birds stop and feed as they move from one part of the world to another.

For example, a bird called the bar-tailed godwit migrates from the Arctic. It flies all the way to Australia and New Zealand. Along the way, the small birds stop in China, North Korea and South Korea.

The problem is that many of these small birds die along their migration because they don’t have a safe place to eat and rest. There is no place to restore their energy.

The researchers say countries need to work together and come up with safe stopover areas for birds.
